cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

mechanism: A makes formal recording of B agreement a condition A controls, refusing to let B decide that a provisional or spoken acknowledgment is sufficient.
confusable: General paperwork fussiness is confusable: the record must specifically preserve a position against later revision, while A governs what acknowledgment counts.
comparison: Festival budget uses an admitted past reversal; boundary fence accommodates a neighbor reluctance to promise forever before money is spent.
seedUse: Read all four canonical seeds. Preserve dated acknowledgment and limited present consent; replace generic rank clauses with actual decisions on when B acknowledgment is complete.
